brand_voice.tone: Warm, knowledgeable, reassuring — an experienced neighbor who happens to know ships.
preferred_usage: Refer to packages as "bundles" (lowercase) or by full name, e.g., "the 7-Night Western Caribbean Cruise Bundle"
Emphasize the human-in-the-loop: quotes are reviewed by a real advisor within 1 business day
Use "all-in pricing" when describing quotes (taxes and fees included)
Use "vacation bundles" or "trip bundles" instead of "cruise bundles" where applicable
avoid: "Cheapest" or "discount" claims — positioning is value and completeness, not lowest price
Automated-booking language; bookings are finalized by the advisor, not a bot
Guaranteeing specific port calls or weather-dependent experiences

boilerplate.short: Sunset & Sail Travel packages round-trip airfare, hotels, transfers, car rentals, and destination tickets into one all-inclusive vacation bundle, with a real travel advisor on every booking.
boilerplate.standard: Sunset & Sail Travel is a destination travel specialist that packages air travel, hotels, car rentals, and destination tickets into a single all-inclusive quote centered on cruise sailings. Bundles feature protected-airfare options, pre-cruise hotel stays, port transfers timed to each sailing, and destination tickets — reviewed and supported by a licensed human advisor, with replies to quote requests within one business day. Based in Tampa, Florida, serving clients across the U.S. and Canada.
boilerplate.long_form: [Optional: Expand on founding story, specialty routes (Caribbean, Alaska, Mediterranean), and why the human-in-the-loop model reduces risk for vacation travelers.]

specialties: Round-trip vacation bundle packaging (air + cabin + hotel + transfers + tickets)
Pre-cruise hotel coordination with port transfers
Missed-ship protection via bundled airfare programs
